title: AI generated images
content: I was just scrolling on my tiktok for you page, and this random video came up and it was a series of photos of AI generated images of cities or countries in the future. Anyways, I just had to screen shot these 2 because they are very similar to my mall world and many of yours; the open air balconies and the many tall (towers isn't the right word) but buildings I guess. Just so familiarand I thought i would share.
